events.name: Beach Day (Optional)
events.description:
Balsamar Beach Club
Km 71.5, Carretera del Litoral, Jicalapa, La Libertad, El Salvador
events.details: Let’s kick off the wedding weekend at the beach! Join us at Balsamar Beach Club on El Salvador’s Pacific coast for sunshine, waves, and black sand. Fun fact: the sand is black because it comes from El Salvador’s volcanoes! We’ll take care of the ride there, so all you need is a swimsuit, sunscreen, and a towel. Entrance is $20, and lunch and drinks will be available to buy.

events.name: Night Out (Optional)
events.details: It wouldn’t be a trip to El Salvador without a night at the discotecas! After the beach, come celebrate with us at the place where Juanpa and I first got to know each other. We’ll have vans to take everyone there and back, so just wear something fun that you can dance in.

events.name: Holy Hour (Optional)
events.description:
Iglesia María Auxiliadora
Lago de Coatepeque, Santa Ana, El Salvador
events.details: Please join us for a quiet hour of prayer and reflection at a church by Lago de Coatepeque. Holy Hour is a Catholic tradition that goes back to the night before Jesus died, when he asked his friends in the garden to stay and pray with him for one hour. For us, it’s a chance to slow down, give thanks, and ask God to bless our marriage before we say “I do.” A priest will also be there to hear confessions for anyone who would like to receive the Sacrament of Reconciliation. All are welcome! Since we’ll head straight to the welcome cocktail afterward, come dressed in cocktail attire and ready for the evening.

events.name: Welcome Cocktail (Optional)
events.details: After Holy Hour, hop on the bus for a quick five-minute ride to Juanpa’s family lake house for a cozy evening overlooking Lago de Coatepeque. We’ll toast to the weekend ahead with drinks, games, and a few sweet speeches from the wedding party. Come hungry, because dinner is pupusas, El Salvador’s famous stuffed corn tortillas, and trust us, one is never enough! Attire is cocktail, so dress up and get ready for a beautiful night by the lake.

events.name: Wedding Ceremony
events.description:
Basílica de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe 
Carretera a Santa Tecla, Antiguo Cuscatlán, La Libertad, El Salvador
events.details: The heart of the weekend! Please join us as we exchange vows at the Basílica de Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe. Shuttles will pick everyone up from the hotels and get you to the Basilica 30 minutes early, so you’re seated before the ceremony begins. Once we’re officially married, shuttles will take everyone straight from the Basilica to the reception at Cajamarca. Attire is formal, so think floor-length gowns in fun colors, heels, and suits for the men. Come dressed to impress!

events.name: Reception & After Party
events.description:
Bosque de Cajamarca
Calle al Boquerón Km 22.5, Volcán de San Salvador, Nejapa, San Salvador, El Salvador
events.details: Time to celebrate! Once we’re officially married, shuttles will whisk everyone from the Basilica up the San Salvador volcano to Cajamarca for the party of the weekend. Expect dinner, an open bar, a few surprises we can’t tell you about yet, and a dance floor that won’t empty all night. If you’ve never been to a Latin wedding, consider this your warning: we dance until the sun comes up, so save some energy and wear shoes you can move in! Ladies, bring a light shawl, because it gets breezy up on the volcano at night.

events.name: Farewell Brunch
events.description:
Il Buongustaio
Boulevard del Hipódromo #605, Colonia San Benito, San Salvador, El Salvador
events.details: After a night of dancing until sunrise, let’s refuel together before you head home! If you’re traveling from out of town, join us for one last breakfast before your flight. It’s completely optional, but we’d love the chance to hug you goodbye and thank you for celebrating with us. Breakfast is $20 per person, so please bring cash.
